opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities with at least one year of annual accounts. Must meet the Foundation's funding criteria and complete the eligibility quiz.
opportunities.summary: Open‑year‑round funding for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activities. No submission deadline. Grants are typically 10‑20% of an organisation’s total annual budget, up to £100,000. Proposals limited to 10 pages.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities with at least one year of annual accounts. For major grants, either the organisation’s annual income must be over £1 million (core cost grants) or the total project or capital cost must be at least £1 million (capital/project grants).
opportunities.summary: Major Grants of £100,000 and above are considered at eight board meetings per year. Applications are submitted via an Expression of Interest, open all year with no deadline, and reviewed on a rolling basis. Grants may fund core costs (for organisations with >£1 m income) or capital/project costs (total cost ≥£1 m).
